### O10 — gate preflight can omit its deadline hint and beat when Git root discovery exhausts the shared verification deadline

- **Symptom:** gate preflight can omit its deadline hint and beat when Git root discovery exhausts the shared verification deadline
- **Evidence:**
  - **Tool:** gate_preflight
  - **Expected:** A deadline-expired verification emits an explicit not-checked deadline hint and an observation row even if setup times out
  - **Actual:** Fathom owned test TestGatePreflightNamesARefusedClaimAndAMissingPassingRun returned an empty slow-call line and only three prior beat rows; the default-concurrency full downstream gate failed
  - **Repro:** Fathom source 8d11ad6837f3d3e2a5859fe95d876bfe5978e285, kit 9f8349ed1abca0c03bd6f3231714cd067488ad9f. Run the named cmd/fathom test with race and count=1: baseline passes. In scratch PATH, delay only the fourth rev-parse --show-toplevel in the fixture cwd by150ms: it fails with the same empty line and three rows. gatepreflight.go137 creates50ms context before git139; git error returns140-141 before emitBeat172. Original failing-run Git duration was not measured; this experiment proves the causal mechanism. No source or assertion edits.
- **Root cause:** The verification deadline starts before Git root discovery. A context error there returns before the deadline hint and beat emission. The injected-delay experiment reproduces this branch; the original failing run did not measure Git latency, so that original attribution remains inferred.
- **Fix:** Fathom main 2974c3153 preserves deadline reporting after Git discovery times out in a filesystem-confirmed work tree. A deterministic discovery seam proves commit/push hints and observations; ordinary errors, cancellation, outside repositories and the tested Git redirects stay silent. The shared deadline is unchanged. Disabling the fallback with the seam present reproduces the missing hints and rows.
- **Status:** closed
- **Impact:** The original default-concurrency run failed one owned test; its Git latency was not measured. Focused race regressions and full Fathom validation now pass, including 2,234 command tests. The final descendant 07b249ca5d7811f9778f3ec111f59e6d029ee0bc passed exact-tree proof (2,273 claimed rows), the unchanged RSS canary and pre-push validation, was pushed to main, and `task deploy` asserted the managed daemon serves 07b249ca5d78. See docs/evidence/catalog-kit/2026-10-21/downstream.md for the separately scoped kit integration result.
